scripts.build:production: pnpm nx run ghost:build:tsc && pnpm nx run ghost:build:assets && pnpm nx run @tryghost/admin:build
scripts.dev:docker: export pnpm_config_enable_global_virtual_store=false && pnpm install && pnpm nx run ghost-monorepo:docker:dev
scripts.dev:sqlite: export pnpm_config_enable_global_virtual_store=false && pnpm install && DEV_COMPOSE_FILES='-f compose.dev.sqlite.yaml' pnpm nx run ghost-monorepo:docker:dev
scripts.dev:full: DEV_COMPOSE_FILES='-f compose.dev.analytics.yaml -f compose.dev.storage.yaml' ANALYTICS_PROXY_TARGET=127.0.0.1:7182 ./docker/stripe/with-stripe.sh nx run ghost-monorepo:dev:host:public
scripts.dev:analytics: DEV_COMPOSE_FILES='-f compose.dev.analytics.yaml' ANALYTICS_PROXY_TARGET=127.0.0.1:7182 nx run ghost-monorepo:dev:host
scripts.dev:all: DEV_COMPOSE_FILES='-f compose.dev.analytics.yaml -f compose.dev.storage.yaml' ANALYTICS_PROXY_TARGET=127.0.0.1:7182 ./docker/stripe/with-stripe.sh nx run ghost-monorepo:dev:host
scripts.dev:daemon: NX_DAEMON=true NX_TUI=false NX_DEFAULT_OUTPUT_STYLE=stream nx run ghost-monorepo:dev:host
scripts.fix: pnpm store prune && rimraf -g '**/node_modules' && pnpm install && pnpm nx reset
scripts.knex-migrator: cd ghost && pnpm exec node ../scripts/with-ghost-dev-env.ts env NODE_OPTIONS='--conditions=source --import=tsx' knex-migrator
scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && bash scripts/init-submodules.sh && git config --local blame.ignoreRevsFile .git-blame-ignore-revs
scripts.migrate:db: cd ghost && pnpm exec node ../scripts/with-ghost-dev-env.ts env NODE_OPTIONS='--conditions=source --import=tsx' knex-migrator migrate
scripts.rollback:db: cd ghost && pnpm exec node ../scripts/with-ghost-dev-env.ts env NODE_OPTIONS='--conditions=source --import=tsx' knex-migrator rollback
scripts.reset:db: cd ghost && pnpm exec node ../scripts/with-ghost-dev-env.ts env NODE_OPTIONS='--conditions=source --import=tsx' sh -c 'knex-migrator reset && knex-migrator init'
scripts.reset:db:volume: docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml ${DEV_COMPOSE_FILES} --profile docker-dev down && docker volume rm ghost-dev_mysql-data
scripts.reset:data: cd ghost && pnpm exec node ../scripts/with-ghost-dev-env.ts node --conditions=source --import=tsx index.js generate-data --clear-database --quantities members:1000,posts:100 --seed 123
scripts.reset:data:empty: cd ghost && pnpm exec node ../scripts/with-ghost-dev-env.ts node --conditions=source --import=tsx index.js generate-data --clear-database --quantities members:0,posts:0 --seed 123
scripts.reset:data:xxl: cd ghost && pnpm exec node ../scripts/with-ghost-dev-env.ts node --conditions=source --import=tsx index.js generate-data --clear-database --quantities members:2000000,posts:0,emails:0,members_stripe_customers:0,members_login_events:0,members_status_events:0 --seed 123
scripts.seed:multi-sub-scenarios: cd ghost && pnpm exec node ../scripts/with-ghost-dev-env.ts node --conditions=source --import=tsx scripts/seed-multi-sub-scenarios.js
scripts.docker:clean: docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml ${DEV_COMPOSE_FILES} --profile docker-dev --profile all down -v --remove-orphans --rmi local
scripts.docker:rebase: export pnpm_config_enable_global_virtual_store=false && git fetch ${GHOST_UPSTREAM:-origin} main && git rebase ${GHOST_UPSTREAM:-origin}/main && pnpm install && pnpm nx run-many -t build --projects=@tryghost/shade,@tryghost/admin-x-framework && docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml ${DEV_COMPOSE_FILES} --profile docker-dev up -d --build --force-recreate ghost-dev
scripts.lint: pnpm nx run-many -t lint lint:boundaries && pnpm lint:packages && pnpm lint:versioning && pnpm lint:docs
scripts.lint:docs: pnpm lint:agent-skills && pnpm lint:agent-guidance && pnpm lint:markdown && pnpm lint:doc-links
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm test
scripts.main:monorepo: git checkout main && git pull ${GHOST_UPSTREAM:-origin} main && pnpm install
scripts.main:submodules: git submodule sync && git submodule update && git submodule foreach "git checkout main && git pull ${GHOST_UPSTREAM:-origin} main"
scripts.tb: docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml -f compose.dev.analytics.yaml run --rm --no-deps --entrypoint tb tb-cli --local

options.command: if [ -n "$CODESPACES$REMOTE_CONTAINERS" ]; then echo 'Skipping docker compose up --force-recreate: already running inside a devcontainer, whose own compose lifecycle brought these services up.'; else docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml ${DEV_COMPOSE_FILES} --profile docker-dev up -d --force-recreate --wait --quiet-pull; fi

if [ -n "$CODESPACES$REMOTE_CONTAINERS" ]; then echo 'Skipping docker compose build: already running inside a devcontainer, whose own compose lifecycle built/pulled these images.'; else docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml ${DEV_COMPOSE_FILES} --profile docker-dev build; fi
trap 'docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml ${DEV_COMPOSE_FILES} --profile docker-dev down' EXIT; docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml ${DEV_COMPOSE_FILES} --profile docker-dev logs -f
